title: The store's layout, contracts and capture rules: three tiers, eight model types, a rule per task that flags and never deletes
request: The storing phase: a structured store (raw, records, sets) for eight model types, every path in one place, contracts good enough to train on years later, and a capture rule per task whose checks label data and never remove it.
plan: Contracts in dclab_core/store.py: a kept source, provenance, a normalised record, the examples of each model type, a curator's choice, a set's manifest.
A CaptureRule per task with check() returning findings, never a bare pass.
dclab_rnd/store: one layout module for every path, an append-only store with hashes and versions, the catalog with its schemas.
The store's root a clone of the owner's private records repository on its owner branch.

decisions.decision: Validation labels and routes; it never deletes.
decisions.why: The owner: the guardrails must not prevent capturing the data; a failure is data too.

decisions.decision: Every assistant turn carries its reasoning with its source, or says why it has none.
decisions.why: Every LLM example reasons (the owner), and a reasoning of unknown origin cannot be weighed.

decisions.decision: A decision example's state passes the ledger's state check.
decisions.why: A row never enters a training set; the ledger already refuses table values in a state.

decisions.decision: The bulk goes to a separate private repository, the R&D repository keeps the catalog.
decisions.why: The owner's answer: clones stay small; one branch per person.

change: dclab_core.store (eight model types, the raw kinds, StoreEntry, Provenance, StoreRecord, DecisionExample, Message, ChatExample, PreferencePair, TrajectoryStep, SolverTrajectory, Episode, JudgedExample, RetrievalExample, CurationDecision, SetManifest, WorkflowRecord), dclab_core.store_rules (CaptureRule, check), dclab_rnd.store (layout, store, catalog, tasks, CLI), the private repository dclab-records; dclab-core 0.98.0.

findings.defect: Two sources could share one entry id.
findings.scenario: experience/a.jsonl and experience-a.jsonl both became sessions:w1:experience-a.jsonl:v1.
findings.cause: The id was built from a slug of the source.
findings.fix: The id and the file name carry a hash of the source.

findings.defect: A long source name refused the capture and left an orphan file.
findings.scenario: A 301-character source raised after its blob was written.
findings.cause: The entry was validated after the write.
findings.fix: The entry is validated before anything is written; a source may be long.

findings.defect: One torn index line broke the kind for good.
findings.scenario: A write cut short left half a line; every later keep raised.
findings.fix: A torn line is set aside to index.torn.jsonl; the blob is flushed before its index line.

findings.defect: The late check never fired on real decisions.
findings.scenario: A decision with no state time passed with no finding.
findings.cause: The check ran only when a state time existed.
findings.fix: A decision without both times is flagged untimed.

findings.scenario: A person's label (user_decision_exposed) was not in the confirming list.
findings.cause: The ledger's and the store's label words disagreed.
findings.fix: One vocabulary, the ledger's words mapped into the store's in check().

findings.defect: Rules that feed sets had no key to seal by.
findings.scenario: A teacher's answer on a sealed decision could reach a train split.
findings.fix: Every rule that feeds a set names its sealed key; a teacher's answer requires its group.

findings.defect: An example's state took table values.
findings.scenario: state={'sample': an e-mail and a card number} was accepted.
findings.cause: The state was a free mapping.
findings.fix: The ledger's state check runs on decision and episode states.

findings.defect: Reasoning labels were not enforced in a v1 that would be frozen.
findings.scenario: An assistant turn with no reasoning, or a source with no reasoning, was accepted.
findings.fix: Both together, and an assistant turn without one says why.

findings.defect: A read followed an index path outside the store.
findings.scenario: A merged branch's index could name ../../ any file.
findings.fix: Every read goes through the layout, refused outside the root.

findings.defect: The catalog of a scratch store replaced the repository's.
findings.cause: The copy's path was the default for every root.
findings.fix: The copy is written only for the owner's store.

outcome: DCLab has one structured store with its contracts, its capture rules and an append-only core, its root a private repository with a branch per person.
lessons: Freeze a contract only after a review: v1 is forever.
A check that can pass silently on missing data is not a check: report absence as a finding.
risks: The examples' shapes are untested against a real training run until the sets are built.
